_comment: Rule id -> nonempty proof entries. limit: section and exact CASES.md passage (proof route). test or macos_evidence: repository-relative file and top-level Test function; evidence file must carry macos_evidence build tag. Unproved ids belong in unmapped-rules.txt.

QA5.route: - QA5: the warning is text in the documentation and on the terminal, and a case expects only the judge's output and the exit code.

QE12.route: - QE12: next actions appear on the scorecard, which a case does not expect.

QE15.route: - QE15: the judge rejects only a record that breaks the judge contract, and a collector that follows this specification sends none, so no case input leads to one.

QE17.route: - QE17: where records are stored is neither a case input nor part of what a case expects.

QE20.route: - QE20: removing homes, scratch directories and private copies is neither a case input nor part of what a case expects.

QH1.route: - QH1: the system's version is not a case input. A scripted run takes whether confinement was applied from the host file (QT4), which `case-003` and `case-004` force.

QH2.route: - QH2: whether the system accepts the profile is not a case input. Its effect, confinement not applied, is QT4's `confinement` field.

QH3.route: - QH3: the user the engine runs as is not a case input.

QH11.route: - QH11: the profile is a fixed text, and a scripted run applies no profile (QT3).

QH13.route: - QH13: a scripted run starts no process (QT3), so it has no descriptors or terminal to set up.

QH18.route: - QH18: a computation's own calls are not recorded, and a scripted run starts no process (QT3).

QH19.route: - QH19: a child that leaves its process group is beyond what the engine observes, so no recording can show it.

The other stated limits are things the engine cannot observe, so no recording can show them: a leak through the system's unified log (QP14), another process reading the planted file (QP14, QH28), a read of no bytes at the end of the file (QP14, QH28), a directory-server lookup (QP14), a copy of the subject's binary at another path (QH17), and a child that leaves its process group (QH19).

QH23.route: - QH23: a scripted run starts no process (QT3), so it has no process group to end.

QP14.route: - QP14: each limit it states is something the engine cannot observe, so no recording can show it.

The other stated limits are things the engine cannot observe, so no recording can show them: a leak through the system's unified log (QP14), another process reading the planted file (QP14, QH28), a read of no bytes at the end of the file (QP14, QH28), a directory-server lookup (QP14), a copy of the subject's binary at another path (QH17), and a child that leaves its process group (QH19).

QE18.route: - QE18: masking shows in `expected`, `observed` and the scorecard, which QE19 does not compare; the recordings are masked before recording (QT5).

QH10.route: - QH10: the profile's kill on refusal shows in a scripted record only as a recorded kill, which QO3 decides.

QH12.route: - QH12: the environment the engine builds is part of a real run; a scripted run passes no environment to anything.

QH15.route: - QH15: what the profile allows shows in a scripted record only as recorded ends.

QH16.route: - QH16: a computation's profile shows in a scripted record only as a computation's recorded end, which QO6 decides.

QH20.route: - QH20: a computation's lack of network shows in a scripted record only as its recorded end.

QH22.route: - QH22: a refusal turned into a kill shows in a scripted record only as a recorded kill.

QH21.route: - `case-077` shows that a subject that kills itself with `SIGKILL` reads as a kill by the confinement (QH21), so it is not measured rather than red.

QD6.route: - `case-026` shows a subject that ignores a help request and runs that command's action inside the confinement, in an empty home (QD6).

QH28.route: The other stated limits are things the engine cannot observe, so no recording can show them: a leak through the system's unified log (QP14), another process reading the planted file (QP14, QH28), a read of no bytes at the end of the file (QP14, QH28), a directory-server lookup (QP14), a copy of the subject's binary at another path (QH17), and a child that leaves its process group (QH19).
